status: Nation creation receipt recovery is not implemented; the overall goal remains open.

findings.observation: Recovery infers debit/refund from current balance; ordinary deposit has no original operation receipt.
Creation has no pending-journal admission guard; the file journal save replaces the existing intent.
Claim charges before claiming chunks; compensation is an in-memory loop followed by an unchecked ordinary refund.
Committed split tolerates journal cleanup failure; ordinary catalog changes remain possible; recovery writes the old full snapshot based on claim ownership alone.
External cleanup failure retains the disband journal, but another disband can replace its single pending intent.
